name: Surfer
description: A man in his mid twenties, a sun-bleached surfer who sings sixties surf rock, unhurried and easygoing.
build: A long lean paddler's build: wide shoulders tapering to a narrow waist, long ropy arms, long legs, loose and upright with softly straight knees.
face: Deep golden-tanned skin, pale blue eyes under sun-bleached brows, a slightly peeling sunburnt nose, a wide mouth and a light blond stubble.
hair: Shaggy shoulder-length sun-bleached blond hair in big salty clumps, parted in the middle and tucked behind the ears.
outfit: A short-sleeved, short-legged spring wetsuit, black with a wide bold turquoise panel across the chest and down both sides, the legs ending above the knee and the sleeves above the elbow; bare forearms, bare hands and bare feet. His head is bare.
performance_style: Loose and easy: feet hip-width apart, weight sunk on the character-left leg. Both arms hang loose at his sides, the character-right and character-left hands open, empty, fingers visible. Head tilted slightly, a lazy half-lidded look.
location: A surf break at golden hour seen from wet sand at the waterline running to the bottom of the frame, a tall green-blue wave curling behind, a longboard stuck upright in the sand at one side, and a warm orange sky.
recognition_cues: a black spring wetsuit with a wide turquoise chest panel
bare feet and a deep tan

sing.intent: Surf-rock vocal loop: the mic in the character-right hand comes to the mouth, the character-left hand sways low and open like riding a wave, knees bob gently, then back to the loose stance. The mouth must visibly open and change shape across the loop so the character unmistakably reads as singing.

animations.flinch: A gull squawks close: he ducks his head and hunches, then shakes it off and relaxes. No opponent or contact.
animations.guard: One-shot: knees bend into a low surfer's stance, the character-left arm out forward and the character-right arm back, hands open; hold balanced. Not combat.
animations.entrance: One-shot: ambles in barefoot, shakes the water from his hair, settles into the loose stance.
animations.victory: One-shot: throws both hands up with thumbs and little fingers out in a shaka, head back laughing, holds.
animations.ko: Non-contact defeat: his shoulders slump, both open hands dangle, and his head sags with the hair falling forward. Stays standing on both planted feet in every frame — no kneeling, crouching, sitting, sinking or going to the ground. No impact, injury or opponent.
